Now I'll view one reference image from the most likely class.

The reference image confirms Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers shows dark stem cankers at the base — a macroscopic field symptom. The test image is a microscopic view of the causal pathogen's conidia: multicellular, muriform-septate (both transverse and longitudinal septa), golden-brown, pear-to-clavate shaped with tapered beaks. These are textbook Alternaria conidia (~20-40 μm), the causal agent of Alternaria black mold/stem cankers on tomato.
